The likely fault is in [newClusterSessionSameCluster](/app/lib/kube/proxy/forwarder.go:1454): it requires a matching kube_service registration before checking `Forwarder.creds`. A cluster with valid local credentials can therefore return `trace.NotFound`.

Endpoint selection in [dialWithEndpoints](/app/lib/kube/proxy/forwarder.go:1391) updates the session address during dialing, while forwarding headers are set earlier and can use `LocalKubernetes` as a fallback. The fix should keep the selected dial endpoint and recorded session address consistent, including when multiple endpoints are available or none are available.

One requirement needs reconciliation with existing behavior: [newClusterSession](/app/lib/kube/proxy/forwarder.go:1418) accepts an empty `kubeCluster` for remote sessions, and an [existing test](/app/lib/kube/proxy/forwarder_test.go:649) expects that to succeed. I inspected the code and tests; I did not change project source or run tests.

Updated [forwarder.go](/app/lib/kube/proxy/forwarder.go) so session creation rejects a missing or unknown Kubernetes cluster with `trace.NotFound`, uses local credentials before looking for kube_service registrations, and records one selected endpoint for consistent headers and dialing. Remote sessions use `LocalKubernetes`.

Updated the session tests. `go test ./lib/kube/proxy -count=1` and `git diff --check` pass.

VERDICT: FIX

**Code defect:** [forwarder.go](/app/lib/kube/proxy/forwarder.go:1554) selects one `kube_service` endpoint per session, and [clusterSession.dial](/app/lib/kube/proxy/forwarder.go:1401) returns immediately if that endpoint fails. With one unavailable service and one healthy service, connections can fail depending on which is selected. Restore attempts across the discovered endpoints, recording the address and `serverID` of the endpoint that succeeds.

**Tests:** `go test ./lib/kube/proxy -run 'Test(NewClusterSession|DialWithEndpoints)$' -count=1` passed; `go test ./lib/kube/proxy -count=1` passed. The existing tests do not cover one failed endpoint among multiple services.

**TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM:** None.

Fixed kube_service dialing so a failed selected endpoint is followed by attempts to the other discovered endpoints. The session records the address and server ID of the endpoint that succeeds. Added a regression test with one failed service and one healthy service.

Both reviewer flagged test commands pass, as does `git diff --check`. No remaining failures or test environment problems.
